notes: Retrospective replay of the 2025-06-01 count, not pre-registered.

Units on the map are the 16 voivodeships. The model runs over 128 cells (voivodeship x gmina-size class) plus abroad and ships, which are counted but not drawn. PKW published the count only by voivodeship and by size class, so each cell's counted votes are reconstructed from those two sets of totals (docs/poland.md).

The count is replayed from 26 archived PKW versions (20:59-05:13 CEST by PKW's own version time); the Internet Archive did not keep every version, so gaps of an hour or more occur (runoff: none between 22:00 and 23:11 UTC, nor between 01:07 and 03:13 UTC).

'Counted' is the share of the expected votes counted (electorate counted, from PKW's own voter counts); 'raw' and 'share' are Trzaskowski's share of the Trzaskowski + Nawrocki vote, abroad included. Map prior = the 2020 runoff (Trzaskowski vs Duda) by voivodeship.
Official final (PKW, summed from the last archived version; the gmina csv agrees): Trzaskowski 10,237,286, Nawrocki 10,606,877; Trzaskowski 49.11% of the two-way vote.
Margin bands (Nawrocki 0-4, 4-8, over 8; Trzaskowski 0-4, 4-8) are priced from the same normal distribution of the final share, in points of valid votes.

Evidence: Retrospective replay, not pre-registered. Before the settings were frozen the archived PKW versions were downloaded and decoded, and an earlier voivodeship-level version of the model was run on the runoff count with default settings (no settings chosen). The frozen settings (configs/pl2025r2_v1.toml) come only from the 2025 round-1 count night, an earlier election; no runoff count went into any setting. The round-1 settings did not transfer well: the runoff's 90% band held the final share in under half the minutes from 1% to 95% counted.

Two settings, side by side. v1 (headline, configs/pl2025r2_v1.toml): tau 0.005, rho 0.8, chosen on the 2025 round-1 night alone before the runoff was scored. v2 (sensitivity, configs/pl2025r2_v2.toml): tau 0.03, kappa 100000, rho 0.5, chosen after the runoff result was known because v1 was overconfident: pooled over every earlier night that could be scored (the real round-1 night and a simulated 2020 runoff count, each weighted equally). Only those two exist: the Internet Archive holds no count-night versions of the 2015, 2019 or 2020 elections, and 2023-2024 have one or two snapshots of party-list elections. v2 is shown as the second line on the chart (P_sensitivity) and in the statistics.

sensitivity.label: v2: settings pooled over the 2025 round-1 night and a simulated 2020 runoff count (chosen after the 2025 runoff result was known; not a forward test)

sensitivities.label: tau mixture over earlier nights (chosen after the result was known)
sensitivities.note: An equal-weight mixture over the reporting-order errors that 6 earlier count nights needed (mx2012 0.015, mx2018 0.02, br2022r1 0, br2022r2 0.005, mx2024 0.03, pl2025r1 0.0075). Same point forecast as the base model (rho 0.8, kappa 50,000); only the band and the win chance allow for those 6 different errors instead of one. Built from earlier nights only, but chosen after this result was known, so it is a sensitivity, not a forecast.
